'''Thorpell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a barracks [[Officer/Legends|officer]] within the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed in the Republic's secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. In the prison he operated a stall in the [[Prison Command Center]] of the [[Minimum Security Section]], where he sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from a stall to various Republic personnel. He wore a [[Color/Legends|tan]] uniform and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] while at his stall. Thorpell had fair skin, ginger hair, and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barracks Officer Thorpell appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Armor Vendor for Republic players on Belsavis.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Thorpell was removed from the game along with the rest of the Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
